findings.desc: playbook_auto_promotion_apply and playbook_promotion_sweep can append duplicate or lost recommend_activate rows because they write the same .lattice/learning/playbook-promotion-decisions.jsonl ledger under different locks. The new self-contained apply path stages a recommendation after checking existing idempotency keys in packages/main/src/core/playbook-seed.ts:1241 and appends it in packages/main/src/core/playbook-seed.ts:1388, while sweep does the same idempotency check/append in packages/main/src/handlers/playbook.ts:966 but only holds withLearningStoreLock at packages/main/src/handlers/playbook.ts:1008. Auto-apply instead holds the main/playbook lock via packages/main/src/handlers/playbook.ts:1232, and appendPlaybookPromotionDecision itself only validates then atomic-appends without enforcing idempotency in packages/main/src/core/learning-store.ts:1417. If sweep --apply and auto_promotion_apply --apply overlap on an eligible candidate, each can observe no applied key and append the same deterministic recommendation, or one read-modify-write append can overwrite the other; this violates the story idempotency/duplicate-recommendation safety for the self-contained apply path. Serialize all writers of playbook-promotion-decisions.jsonl on the same lock or make appendPlaybookPromotionDecision enforce idempotency inside the shared lock/write primitive.
